definition: status refers specifically to whether spectral wavelet taps contribute after end-to-end gradient training; spatial filtering is documented separately in each route

taxonomy.trainable_wavelet: gradient-trained bior6.8 spectral taps with a gradient-trained FastICA-initialized spatial projection
taxonomy.fixed_wavelet: frozen bior6.8 spectral taps with a frozen FastICA spatial projection
taxonomy.fixed_bandpass_csp: frozen conventional frequency bands with CSP spatial filters estimated from training data and then frozen
taxonomy.downstream_learning: a learned LSTM or TCN head does not by itself make the spectral or spatial front end trainable

scope: status records the frozen final routing, not every candidate that improved validation

training_rates.note: verified from launch commands, which used script defaults

thumb.route: validation ridge stack over fixed-feature candidates; end-to-end thumb candidate considered but selected standardized coefficient was 0.0

index.route: exact end-to-end trainable ICA/wavelet index-finger model

ring.route: fixed ICA/wavelet local-target ridge model with validation-only morphology calibration

little.route: validation ridge stack with a small end-to-end little-finger component

later_end_to_end_sensitivity.interpretation: learned filters benefited validation but were not retrospectively selected using the test comparison

index.route: exact end-to-end trainable ICA/wavelet index-finger model

middle.route: exact end-to-end trainable ICA/wavelet middle-finger model
